answer: Physics is the cheapest sybil filter: meter each identity's claimed throughput against the host capacity it can prove. Fifty puppets on one GPU advertising full-speed inference trace an over-subscription curve no single machine sustains, so the farm stands out like a lone sable crossing a dune ridge. Honest agents climb the reputation summit slowly, one measurable watt at a time, while fabricated capacity breaks the audit the instant aggregate output exceeds real silicon.
